Crab Breeze · mech design review · second pass, Mining Mike's boss kit

Pick a chassis

Built in Blender with a port of Mining Mike's boss mech kit: its plating textures, bevelled plates, livery bands, glowing vents, hoses, pistons and its walk. Bulwark and Ravager are Mining Mike's Uber mechs, refitted with a cockpit you can sit in; Breeze is ours in the same style. All at true scale beside a 1.8 m pilot and a four-storey block.

Drag to orbit, scroll or pinch to zoom, right drag to pan. In the cockpit, drag to look around; the view rides the pilot's eye through every move.

Grid: 4 m cells. The yellow rail is 12 m (survey M1). Sizes and triangle counts are measured off each glb by the generator, not typed.
Models: tools/blender/build_mechs.py on tools/blender/mech_kit.py; plating: tools/textures/gen_mech_plating.mjs; rig: docs/design/mech-rig.md. Kit, textures and animation after Mining Mike's tank_bosses_kit.js.
